title: The plan and the audit
points: Every figure here comes from plain code and links back to a quoted message.
The six audit checks recompute the figures independently of the solver.

title: A rejected message
points: Each rejection names the rule, the reason and a drafted reply to the sender.
A change that only costs more is accepted. Only changes that make the plan impossible, stale, ungrounded or unauthorised are rejected.

title: Break it live
points: Switch a check off and the red team score drops, the audit fails and the human impact shows.
Nothing here is saved, and no model is called.

title: The rulebook
points: Messages compile into rules with a source quote and slack, next to the planner's own policy rules.
Only the Reader uses a model. Everything else is plain, explainable code.
